scope: Posts and Pages responsive editor geometry plus a real 5,000-word publication guard; preserves auth recovery v315, Full Zone domains v314, Nara v313, Theme/Members v312, onboarding v311, v310 compatibility and the Studio sidebar authority.
notes: The new-draft editor no longer reserves a 980px blank sheet; document height grows with content.
Desktop-site, laptop, computer and large-tablet layouts keep the inspector beside the document.
Application, handphone, mobile and compact-device layouts use one column with readable actions, scrollable tabs/toolbars and contained HTML/preview panels.
The 5,000-word rule never truncates draft content; publish controls are unavailable only while the document exceeds the limit.
Authentication recovery v315 and verified Full Zone custom domains v314 remain authoritative.
No universal-device or extreme login-capacity claim is made without measured production tests.
